dek: Seven nights, four beds, three ferries. One in Patong, two in Ao Nang, the birthday weekend on Phi Phi, two by the sea in Kamala.

rows.act: Patong Beach — swim and sunbeds
rows.note: From your list. Sunbed and umbrella ~100-200 THB for the afternoon, coconuts from the vendors

rows.act: Sunset drinks at Kee Sky Lounge rooftop
rows.note: 360-degree rooftop over Patong Bay, Google 4.6. Sunset is ~6:10 pm. (Your 'Oscar sports bar' doesn't exist under that name — Aussie Bar on Bangla is the famous sports bar, but it rates 4.3)
rows.pdf_act: Sunset drinks at Kee Sky Lounge rooftop

rows.act: Rohan lands (MEL dep 15:15)
rows.note: Booked. Pre-book a Grab or the hostel pickup — in Patong by ~9:15 pm
rows.pdf_act: Rohan lands

rows.act: First dinner, all five — Dang Restaurant
rows.note: Open until 23:30, a few minutes from Bangla. Crab fried rice, yellow curry, tom yum
rows.pdf_act: First dinner, all five — Dang Restaurant

rows.act: Bangla Road, then Illuzion
rows.note: Your one walkable Bangla night — make it count. Mad Monkey's own pub crawl is the cheap way in
rows.pdf_act: Bangla Road, then Illuzion

days.label: Wed 18 Nov
days.title: Shooting range in Patong, afternoon ferry to Krabi
days.tip: The range opens at 10:30 and you need to leave Patong by noon — book the slot on Klook the night before.

rows.act: Breakfast at Uncle Joe
rows.note: French toast, waffles, proper coffee. Open 08:00-17:00
rows.pdf_act: Breakfast at Uncle Joe

rows.act: Pack, keep the room as a base
rows.note: Mad Monkey is booked through the 19th — leave bags in the room while you shoot, shower before the ferry, and ask about crediting the unused night
rows.pdf_act: Pack, keep the room as a base

rows.act: Patong Paragon Shooting Range
rows.note: Opens 10:30, right by Bangla Road — a 5 min walk. Book on Klook at least an hour ahead and bring passports (or a passport photo). Packages mix 9mm, .22 and .38, 10 rounds each. Done by ~11:45
rows.pdf_act: Patong Paragon Shooting Range

rows.act: Taxi Patong to Rassada Pier
rows.note: ~45 min, ~800-1,000 THB per car. Leave a buffer — you can't miss this one
rows.pdf_act: Taxi Patong to Rassada Pier

rows.note: Confirm the Slot — afternoon sailings vary by season. 1h15-2h, ~800-1,100 THB pp
rows.pdf_act: Ferry Phuket to Krabi

rows.note: ~30 min, ~150-200 THB pp

rows.act: Check in at Nomads Ao Nang
rows.note: Booked 18-20 Nov. Bar, pool, beach on the doorstep

rows.act: Ao Nang sunset — and book tomorrow
rows.note: Tonight: lock in the morning option and the 4 Islands sunset tour. Both are cheaper booked locally
rows.pdf_act: Ao Nang sunset — and book tomorrow

rows.act: Dinner at Jungle Kitchen
rows.note: Proper Thai for sharing, Google 4.7 from 2,000 reviews. The Landmark night market is a 5 min walk if you want a wander after
rows.pdf_act: Dinner at Jungle Kitchen

rows.act: Bamboo Beach Club
rows.note: Dj sets and fire shows on the sand, Google 4.7. Tribe Beach Bar (4.6) is the smaller, clubbier alternative
rows.pdf_act: Bamboo Beach Club

days.label: Thu 19 Nov
days.title: Your pick of morning, four islands at sunset
days.tip: Island pickups run 12:00-12:50. Whatever you choose for the morning, be back in Ao Nang by 11:30.

rows.act: Optional: Tiger Cave Temple at dawn — or another morning below
rows.note: 1,260 steps, about an hour up; go at first light before the heat. Or kayak, ATV, the elephant shelter, or a slow morning — all in the options. Back in Ao Nang by ~11:30 for the 12:15 pickup
rows.pdf_act: Optional: Tiger Cave Temple at dawn — or another morning below

rows.act: Back in Ao Nang, quick lunch at Ton Ma Yom
rows.note: Home-style Thai, most mains under 150 THB. Dinner is on the boat
rows.pdf_act: Back in Ao Nang, quick lunch at Ton Ma Yom

rows.act: Pickup — 7 Islands Sunset + BBQ + Plankton
rows.note: Klook emails the exact pickup time. Longtail or speedboat — pick longtail. Or the Hong Island version — both are on the board below
rows.pdf_act: Pickup — 7 Islands Sunset + BBQ + Plankton

rows.act: Yawasom snorkel, Chicken Island, Tup-Mor sandbar, Tang Ming
rows.note: The sandbar walk between Tup and Mor only appears at low tide
rows.pdf_act: Yawasom snorkel, Chicken Island, Tup-Mor sandbar, Tang Ming

rows.act: Sunset BBQ dinner on Koh Poda
rows.note: Thai buffet dinner included
rows.pdf_act: Sunset BBQ dinner on Koh Poda

rows.act: Night swim with bioluminescent plankton off Koh Raeng
rows.note: Weather permitting. Bring cash for the national park fee, ~300-400 THB pp
rows.pdf_act: Night swim with bioluminescent plankton off Koh Raeng

rows.act: Rooftop drinks at Sea Salt
rows.note: Sixth-floor rooftop bar and grill, Google 4.7. Muay Thai at Ao Nang stadium instead if anyone still has legs
rows.pdf_act: Rooftop drinks at Sea Salt

items.name: Tiger Cave Temple
items.price: Free entry. Car ~1,200-1,500 THB return, split 5
items.note: The one you asked for: 1,260 steps, about an hour up. Dawn only — after 9 am the heat is brutal. 2 L of water each, trainers.

items.name: Ao Thalane mangrove kayaking
items.note: Calm-water paddling through limestone and mangroves.

items.name: Krabi Elephant Shelter
items.note: Feeding and care, no riding. The highest-rated morning option on Klook.

items.name: ATV Extreme, Ao Nam Mao
items.note: 10 min from Ao Nang. Book the earliest slot so you're back for the pickup.
items.q: ATV Extreme, Ao Nam Mao Krabi

items.name: Slow morning
items.note: Breakfast, Ao Nang beach, a Thai massage. Saves the legs for the boat.

items.name: 7 Islands sunset + BBQ + plankton
items.note: Yawasom, Chicken, Tup-Mor sandbar, Tang Ming, sunset dinner on Poda, plankton swim at Koh Raeng. Longtail or speedboat.

items.name: Hong Island sunset + BBQ + plankton
items.price: From ~US$62 on Klook, +300 THB park fee
items.note: Hong lagoon, Pakbia sandbar, plankton. The Hong 360 viewpoint is 420-450 steps — skippable. Needs 6 to run; it's join-in, so others fill it.

items.name: Standard 4 Islands day tour
items.note: Cheapest and most reviewed — but it uses up the morning, so no Tiger Cave.

days.label: Fri 20 Nov
days.title: Railay, ferry to Phi Phi, birthday eve
days.tip: Loh Dalum is tidal — swim at high tide only. Agree the walk back to Bayview before midnight.

rows.act: Railay by longtail — or yesterday's other option
rows.note: 15 min from Ao Nang, ~150 THB pp each way. Railay West, then a flat walk to Phra Nang Cave Beach — Krabi's best. If you skipped Tiger Cave yesterday, it fits here instead
rows.pdf_act: Railay by longtail — or yesterday's other option

rows.act: Back to Ao Nang, checkout from Nomads
rows.note: Leave bags at the hostel while you eat
rows.pdf_act: Back to Ao Nang, checkout from Nomads

rows.act: Lunch, then to the pier
rows.note: Most places drop you at the pier if you book the ferry through them
rows.pdf_act: Lunch, then to the pier

rows.act: Ferry Ao Nang to Koh Phi Phi
rows.note: ~2 hrs, ~650 THB pp. Confirm the Slot — 09:30 is the one confirmed daily sailing
rows.pdf_act: Ferry Ao Nang to Koh Phi Phi

rows.act: Tonsai: island fee, check in at Bayview Resort
rows.note: Booked 20-22 Nov, 2 rooms. Small pier fee (20 THB) in cash as you step off. Bayview is on the headland — 10-15 min walk to the village, or the resort shuttle boat
rows.pdf_act: Tonsai: island fee, check in at Bayview Resort

rows.act: Sunset: Phi Phi Viewpoint climb or Loh Dalum beach
rows.note: Both are in the options below. The viewpoint stairs start on the east side of Tonsai; Loh Dalum is a flat walk
rows.pdf_act: Sunset: Phi Phi Viewpoint climb or Loh Dalum beach

rows.act: Birthday-eve dinner at Efe
rows.note: Mediterranean grill built for sharing, Google 4.7. Anna's (4.7, European-Thai) is the alternative
rows.pdf_act: Birthday-eve dinner at Efe

rows.act: Reggae Bar — the Muay Thai ring
rows.note: Fights every night, and drunk volunteers get in the ring for free drinks. Watch or volunteer — your call
rows.pdf_act: Reggae Bar — the Muay Thai ring

rows.act: Midnight countdown for Rohan on Loh Dalum
rows.note: The fire shows run the length of the beach. Sort the walk back to Bayview before you start
rows.pdf_act: Midnight countdown for Rohan on Loh Dalum

items.note: Stairs start on the east side of Tonsai — follow the Viewpoint / tsunami evacuation signs. Viewpoint 2 is the classic shot; 3 is 15 min higher and quieter at sunset. Bring a torch for the way down. No alcohol at the top

items.name: Loh Dalum Bay sunset
items.note: Flat walk from the village and first drinks on the sand. Swim only at high tide
items.q: Loh Dalum Bay Koh Phi Phi

days.label: Sat 21 Nov
days.title: Pirate boat day
days.tip: Carry cash onto the boat: the 1,900 THB balance plus the bar. Book dinner for 9 pm, not earlier.

rows.act: Birthday brunch at the Mango Garden
rows.note: A minute from the pier, Google 4.8 from 3,600 reviews — the best breakfast on the island by most accounts. Qoori Qoori (4.8) if you want a sea view
rows.pdf_act: Birthday brunch at the Mango Garden

rows.act: Walk to Relax Bar — check in by 11:30
rows.note: Pirate boat meeting point; the group walks to the boat together. Bring cash: the 1,900 THB balance is paid on board
rows.pdf_act: Walk to Relax Bar — check in by 11:30

rows.act: Phi Phi Pirate Boat — booked
rows.note: Maya Bay (~1 hr), Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, Monkey Beach, Loh Samah — the order shifts with the tide. Kayaks, paddleboards, snorkelling, and jumps off a 7 m board on the top deck. Thai fried rice and fruit on board. Drinks are not included — there is a bar on board, so bring cash. Maya Bay park fee is included
rows.pdf_act: Phi Phi Pirate Boat — booked

rows.act: Sunset on the water
rows.note: Dinner on board at sunset
rows.pdf_act: Sunset on the water

rows.act: Back at Tonsai

rows.pdf_act: Back at Tonsai

rows.act: Birthday Dinner at Pirates House
rows.note: Open-air restaurant and cocktail bar with live music, Google 4.6 from 5,400 reviews. Book a table for five before the boat
rows.pdf_act: Birthday Dinner at Pirates House

rows.act: Birthday night at Sunflower Beach Bar, then the beach
rows.note: Bar on the sand with cliff views, Google 4.5. Then the Loh Dalum fire shows. All walkable
rows.pdf_act: Birthday night at Sunflower Beach Bar, then the beach

days.label: Sun 22 Nov
days.title: Pool afternoon, Kamala sunset, Sunday night in Old Town
days.tip: Sunset on Kamala at 6, Old Town by 7:30. Lard Yai packs up at 10, so eat first and drink after.

rows.act: Optional: Phi Phi Viewpoint 1 + 2 before the ferry
rows.note: Cooler and quieter than sunset, good light around 8. Sunrise is ~06:20 but comes up behind the viewpoint. Back down by 9:00
rows.pdf_act: Optional: Phi Phi Viewpoint 1 + 2 before the ferry

rows.act: Breakfast, pack, settle Bayview
rows.pdf_act: Breakfast, pack, settle Bayview

rows.pdf_act: Ferry Phi Phi to Phuket

rows.pdf_act: Rassada Pier — van to Kamala via Old Town

rows.act: Lunch at Toy-Tor-Toe
rows.note: 10 min from the pier. Tom yum prawn noodles with crispy pork lard, mee nam, pork ribs. Cash only
rows.pdf_act: Lunch at Toy-Tor-Toe

rows.act: Check in at Zenmaya Oceanfront — private pool room

rows.act: Pool, nap, nothing

rows.pdf_act: Pool, nap, nothing

rows.act: Kamala Beach sunset — all five

rows.act: Grab or taxi to Old Town

rows.pdf_act: Grab or taxi to Old Town

rows.act: Sunday Dinner on Lard Yai walking street
rows.note: Graze the street-food stalls on Thalang Rd, or sit down at Kopitiam by Wilai (pad thai, Google 4.6, open till 22:00) right on the street. Bonnee for mango sticky rice until 20:30
rows.pdf_act: Sunday Dinner on Lard Yai walking street

rows.act: Cue Bar rooftop — live bands
rows.note: Open Sundays, closed Mondays — tonight or never. Dibuk House (Google 4.8) round the corner if you want it quieter
rows.pdf_act: Cue Bar rooftop — live bands

rows.act: Taxi back to Kamala
rows.note: Book the ride before the market packs up at 22:00 — taxis thin out after

items.name: Phi Phi Viewpoint 1 + 2
items.note: Cooler and quieter than sunset, best light around 8. Sunrise is ~06:20 but rises behind the viewpoint. Water and drinks are sold at the top

items.name: Sleep in, breakfast at The Mango Garden
items.note: After the birthday night, the honest choice
items.q: The Mango Garden Koh Phi Phi

items.name: Stay by your pool
items.note: The plan. Breezes Pool Bar is downstairs if anyone wants a drink

items.name: Zoo del Mar at Café del Mar

items.name: Lard Yai + Kopitiam by Wilai
items.note: The plan: Sunday street food on Thalang Rd, a sit-down pad thai if you want one, Cue Bar after

items.name: Naka Weekend Market instead
items.note: Bigger and more about shopping — shoes, clothes, electronics. Closes earlier

items.name: Stay in at Zenmaya

days.label: Mon 23 Nov
days.title: Two fly home, three do the luge and Café del Mar
days.tip: Kamala to Bangla is a taxi each way. Book the ride home before the night starts, not after.

rows.act: Kabir + Dev check out, taxi to the airport

rows.act: Breakfast on the sand at Lillo Island
rows.note: Opens 08:00, tables on the beach, Thai and American breakfast sets
rows.pdf_act: Breakfast on the sand at Lillo Island

rows.act: Hanuman World — luge + zipline
rows.note: Gravity karts on 650 m and 1.2 km tracks, ~3 min a run. Luge kart from ~US$21 and ziplines from ~US$23 on Klook — book in the app the night before. ~25 min from Kamala. Go early, queues build after lunch
rows.pdf_act: Hanuman World — luge + zipline

rows.act: Kabir + Dev fly to Kolkata / Bagdogra
rows.note: Booked
rows.pdf_act: Kabir + Dev fly to Kolkata / Bagdogra

rows.note: Beachfront, charcoal-grilled chicken, cheap

rows.act: Laem Singh viewpoint, then Surin Beach

rows.act: Café del Mar — sunset

rows.act: Dinner at Maru Korean BBQ
rows.note: Rat-U-Thit 200 Pi Rd. Last seating before 22:00
rows.pdf_act: Dinner at Maru Korean BBQ

rows.act: Last night out: Bangla Road and Illuzion
rows.note: Taxi each way from Kamala. Go lighter — two of you fly before 1 pm

rows.pdf_act: Rohan + Arjun check out, taxi to the airport

know.title: Phuket airport
items: Arrival card (TDAC)
Each of you files the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card at tdac.immigration.go.th within 3 days of landing — the window opens 14 Nov. Show the QR code at immigration.
Getting out
Grab has the official pickup point inside the terminal (Exit 8, international). A metered taxi to Patong runs ~550-700 THB; the Smart Bus is 100 THB flat but takes ~1h20.
SIM or eSIM

Ais, True and Dtac counters sit in arrivals. Ais is ~299 THB for 8 days / 15 Gb; True and Dtac ~449 THB for 8 days unlimited. Bring your passport — registration takes 10-30 minutes. An eSIM bought before you fly skips the queue.
Change a little
Airport rates are poor. Change ~50 USD for the taxi, the rest at SuperRich or the Patong booths. Clean, unmarked $100 notes get the best rate.

know.title: Cash, cards and ATMs
items: ATMs
Most banks charge 220-250 THB per withdrawal; Aeon ATMs (inside Big C and Lotus's) charge 150. Take out larger amounts less often, and always choose to be charged in baht.
Cards vs cash
Cards work at 7-Eleven, malls and most restaurants. Longtails, tuk-tuks, markets, park fees and most of Phi Phi are cash.
Tipping
Not expected, but welcome. Check sit-down bills for a service charge first; otherwise round up or leave 20-50 THB.

know.title: Phuket
items: Apps
Grab is the most reliable; Bolt is often 20-30% cheaper with fewer cars. Around Patong Beach Road, drop your pin 50-100 m from any taxi rank — drivers there push back on app pickups.
Typical Grab fares
Patong to Old Town ~180-240 THB; Patong to Kata ~100-140. In Kamala expect 10-20 minute waits — order before you need it.
Tuk-tuks
Unmetered. Let them quote, counter at 60-70%, agree the price for the whole vehicle, and expect +30-50% in Patong after midnight. Patong to Kamala ~400-600; Patong to Old Town ~600-900.
Scooters

You'd need a home motorcycle licence plus an IDP with the motorcycle endorsement — without it, insurance is void and helmet fines run 500-2,000 THB. Nothing in this plan needs one; Grab and the Sunday driver cover it.

know.title: Ao Nang and Phi Phi
items: Ao Nang
Grab works (cancellations happen). White songthaews run the beach road until ~8 pm: 20 THB short hops, 60 THB to Krabi Town. A tuk-tuk to Krabi Town is ~400.
Railay longtails
From the booths on Ao Nang beach: 100 THB pp one way 08:00-18:00, 150 after 6 pm, 800 for a private boat. You'll wade in knee-deep — wear shorts and carry a dry bag.
Phi Phi
No cars at all. Pay the 20 THB pier fee in cash as you step off. Most places outside the resorts are cash only, and ATMs charge the usual fee.
Tides
Loh Dalum drains at low tide — swim at high tide. The Tup-Mor sandbar on the Krabi tour only appears at low tide.

know.title: What's changed, what's illegal
items: Alcohol hours
Since 29 May 2026 shops, 7-Eleven and restaurants sell alcohol 11:00 to midnight — the old 2-5 pm break is gone. Licensed bars and clubs can run later. Drinking age is 20; carry a passport copy.
Beaches

Drinking on most public beaches is prohibited — the licensed beach bars are fine, 7-Eleven beers on the sand are not. Patong and other beaches also have smoking bans with heavy fines; smoke only where it's marked.
Cannabis
Prescription-only since mid-2025. Walk-in shops may be operating illegally, and public smoking is fined up to 25,000 THB. Skip it.
Temples and respect
Shoulders and knees covered at Tiger Cave, Wat Chalong and Big Buddha; shoes off in shrines. Never make jokes about the royal family — it's a serious offence.

know.title: Patong especially
items: Jet skis
The classic: operators 'find' damage and demand 40,000 THB or more. Don't rent them on Patong.
Bangla touts
Ping-pong show touts add commission to every drink. Walk into bars yourselves and pay each round as it arrives.
Free tuk-tuk rides
A cheap ride with a 'quick stop' at a gem shop is a commission run. Insist on going direct.
Photo props and rentals
Slow lorises and iguanas for photos are illegal — decline. Never leave a passport as a rental deposit; photograph anything you rent first.
Drinks
Watch buckets being made and never leave a drink alone on Bangla or Loh Dalum.

know.title: Late November
items: Weather

Late November is the turn into the dry season on the Andaman coast: mostly sunny, short showers still possible, the sea calming. Boats can still cancel for weather — if an operator calls it, don't argue.
Swimming
A red flag means no swimming — rip currents are real at Patong and Kata. Sunset is around 6:10 pm.
Heat
Spf50 and a hat for every boat day, and two litres of water each for Tiger Cave. Bottled water to drink; restaurant ice is factory-made and fine.
